query:
ALTER TABLE scheduledTasks 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS totalItems INT,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS processedItems INT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS successCount INT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS failureCount INT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS progress INT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'paused') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL;
